params.name: nmi
params.description: Comma separated list of NMIs. Returns records for the specified NMIs

params.name: installationStage
params.description:
One of “Confirmed” or “Conditional”

Returns records where the DER Record is:
Confirmed – both the Connections and Devices are ‘Confirmed’.
Conditional – at least one Connection or Device is ‘Conditional’

params.name: equipmentType
params.description:
One of:
-	Inverter
-	Other
-	Battery Storage Inverter
-	Controllable Load
-	Hybrid Inverter
-	EVSE V2G
-	EVSE no V2G
-	Rotating Machine
-	Solar PV Inverter

Returns records for the specified equipmentType 

Note: Unknown_equipment is not supported.

params.name: deviceType
params.description:
One of:
-	Solar PV
-	Storage
-	Controlled load
-	Co Tri-generation
-	Fossil
-	Liquid fuel
-	Other
-	Small hydro / Hydro
-	Small wind / Wind
-	Waste to energy
-	Unknown_Device

Returns records for the specified deviceType

params.name: fromCommissioningDate
params.description:
A date in the format: yyyy-mm-dd

Returns records where the CommissioningDate is greater than or equal to this value

params.name: toCommissioningDate
params.description:
A date in the format: yyyy-mm-dd, must be

Returns records where the CommissioningDate is less than or equal to this value

params.name: page
params.description:
A number between 1 and the total number of available pages.

Determines which page of records to return.

params.name: pageSize
params.description:
One of: 25, 50 or 100

Determines how many records are returned in the response.

items.docs:
Retrieve DER Installation records by parameter

Retrieves the current versions of one or more DER records.

At least one query parameter must be provided as outlined in the WEM: Distributed Energy Resource (DER) Register Technical Specification (e.g. by NMI, installation stage, equipment type, device type etc).

Creates a DER installation record in the DER Register for the first time, when an installation does not already exist for the respective NMI in the DER Register, which includes the information required at the installation, AC Connection and DER Device data levels.

Retrieves the current and historical versions of a DER installation (for a single NMI) including the installation, AC Connection and Device details information. 

The returned records have a recordStartDate and recordEndDate indicating when the record was current.
Retrieves a single DER record for the specified NMI. The returned data is the latest version stored in DER Register

Updates a DER Installation record already stored in the DER Register. This may be to:

1.	Update information previously submitted where a change has occurred, is identified as being incomplete, inaccurate or no longer accurate at the installation, AC connection and devices levels.

2.	To add new AC connections and/or devices to an already existing DER installation record.
